unguarded.com.davidleess.dynasty-catchup-guard: the guard itself — self-guarding is circular; hybrid schedule since DG-082 (15-min calendar lattice + StartInterval 900 + RunAtLoad); manual remedy is launchctl kickstart
unguarded.com.davidleess.dynasty-api: KeepAlive service, not a scheduled job (DG-087/SR-12) — no calendar slot to miss; launchd itself restarts it, and a receipts entry for a slotless label would surface as unconfigured and degrade the guard; manual remedy: launchctl kickstart -k for a hang; a SPAWN failure (penalty box) clears only with bootout gui/501/<label> then bootstrap gui/501 <plist> — kickstart cannot clear it

com.davidleess.dynasty-nflverse-usage-ca.note: DG-216. Two shapes of late seasonal feed, and the second is the one that recurs: the file is not published yet, OR it is published and readable with week 1 rows while week 2 is late — which reads as healthy and unchanged, so nothing looks again without a bounded re-check. The capture owner declares which partitions to re-check, including successful current-season ones; the guard obeys `due` and infers no readiness from it. Its list narrows and never instructs, and the capture runs only the intersection. Bounded to hourly per partition. Exit 3 means the capture's own lock is held and nothing ran; an unbroken hour of it is a wedged lock, not patience. This is not a game-aware readiness framework and does not claim every completed game is covered.
